source_of_truth: Operator directive (2026-06-07): finish the operator-console usability layer deferred to 008 — armed-terminal chrome, legacy-page theming onto the existing tokens, and the full five-state surface matrix — so the shipped dashboard feels coherent before expanding architecture intelligence (Plan B/C). Bounded: armed terminal chrome only (no PTY/backend semantics), theme survives legacy pages onto existing --dp-* tokens, state matrix across key surfaces (loading/missing/stale/error/ready), journey tests through the real dashboard shell, no architecture-model changes, no new action execution channel.
completion_test: The armed terminal renders a token-only hazard frame (role=alert, scope label, disarm-only, OFF by default) with no backend change; toggling theme/density visibly re-colours legacy pages via a token bridge; a reusable surface-state classifier + renderer drives loading/missing/stale/error/ready across the key surfaces with stale never shown as fresh; and a real-shell journey (createJarvis().init()) walks each key surface through all five states. No architecture nodes/edges/contract change and no new execution channel.
